name: keel
description: Plan-driven operating layer for coding agents: plan first and get it approved (PLAN.md DRAFT → APPROVED), verify before closing, append-only PROGRESS.md, hash-sealed fresh-context checker. Write-time gate via PreToolUse hook, commit-time gate via git.

interface.shortDescription: Plan first, approve, verify, log — the brake for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: keel makes a coding agent write PLAN.md and stop until you say go, verify every task before marking it done, keep an append-only PROGRESS.md, and never grade its own critical work (a fresh-context checker seals its verdict with the artifact's hash). Rules are injected at session start; the plan gate is enforced at write time (PreToolUse) and at commit time (git pre-commit hook installed by /keel:init).
defaultPrompt: Set up keel in this project (/keel:init)
